title: Integration route record
description: One declared path to a concrete external system, including which identity or workspace within it. The record is deliberately small: it names a path and delegates every readiness question to the separate probe registry. It never carries a credential value, and it authorizes nothing.

route_id.description: Stable slug for this exact path. Several routes for one system family coexist on purpose, so that which account is a routing decision rather than an accident of whichever session is warm.

system.description: Coarse system family. Colloquial names are normalized onto this slug by the resolver.

credential_ref_name.description: A name or path, never a value. Sanctioned styles are a provider-native credential store for a named identity, an environment-variable name, a path to a permission-restricted environment file, and an entry name in an OS credential store.

default_contexts.description: Context tags that make this route the default. A request context matching one of them is a large positive weight in route scoring; a miss on a context-declaring route is a small penalty.

access_probe_id.description: Pointer into the probe registry. Every route must point at an existing, non-mutating probe.

notes.description: Free-text constraints: read-only, reprobe before writes, or a statement that a ready default route is not evidence for this named route.
